correctness.rationale: The update of a part i depends only on K-s_i compared with (r-1)q/2; a mixed part must experience ties at both phases in a two-cycle because a homogeneous part cannot regain mixedness. Tied mixed parts have equal occupancy j, and pure-zero and pure-one parts exchange; equality of total occupancy forces a=b and (c-1)(j-q/2)=0. Thus c=1 permits an arbitrary proper pattern, whereas c>1 forces even q and j=q/2. Exact combinatorial selection yields the displayed multinomial counts N_{r,q}(a), including all-uniform even-r oscillations and the two unanimous fixed states. A symmetric integer threshold-energy with diagonal tie term establishes period at most two; it does not rely on the finite check. Independently checking (r,q)=(5,4) gives F=7778,N(activity8)=4320,N(activity16)=420, matching the frozen bit and occupancy scripts. The proof covers all r,q>=2, not transient basin counts.
